summary: Reproduced corruption in the checked-out GroupCoordinator with TP-rank-distinct tensors, then restricted the PP send-allgather optimization to the known TP-replicated hidden_states and residual keys. Other proxy and auxiliary tensors are now sent whole to the matching pipeline rank.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual GroupCoordinator send_tensor_dict/recv_tensor_dict behavior. Both receiving TP ranks got [1,1,1,1,2,2,2,2], matching neither rank-local sender; the replicated boundary case passed. Raw output: reports/j-300a724a2692/raw/repro_before.log

7 unit tests passed, including allowlisted divisible tensors being sliced, non-allowlisted divisible tensors remaining whole, and allowlisted non-divisible tensors remaining whole. Raw output: reports/j-300a724a2692/raw/unit_parallel_state_full.log

Both receiving TP ranks exactly matched their rank-local sharded sender while the replicated tensor still round-tripped through send-allgather. Raw output: reports/j-300a724a2692/raw/repro_after_final.log

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), actual send_tensor_dict selection kept an 8-element sharded CUDA tensor whole and sliced an 8-element allowlisted replicated CUDA tensor to 4 elements. Raw output: reports/j-300a724a2692/raw/gpu_send_allowlist.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The send-side allowlist logic ran on CUDA tensors on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950; see raw/gpu_send_allowlist.log. The four-rank topology reproduction used Gloo and CPU payloads because only one GPU was assigned.

remaining_limitations: No 4-GPU RCCL tp=2/pp=2 run was possible with the assigned single GPU; the exact four-rank communication path was instead reproduced with Gloo using the actual GroupCoordinator implementation.
No RWKV-7 weights or model-specific implementation were available, so model semantics and greedy decoding were not tested.
The qualified tiny Llama serving fixture was not used because it cannot create the model-specific TP-sharded PPProxyTensors needed to validate this defect.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
